question: A machining-center repair may have affected bracket dimensions. What maintenance checks and quality approvals are needed before production continues and product ships?

**Before production resumes:**

Record functional and safety test results against defined limits; production witnesses the operating check. Keep the machine unavailable if any required check fails. (Maintenance §4)

Verify labels, quantities, packaging, and shipment traceability. Shipment remains blocked until checks and approvals are complete; designated Quality release authority signs and dates release. (Quality §§3–4)
